科研.title: LLM代理人什么时候应该忘记？查询关键解析器错误下的内存过滤
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM memory systems often delete facts classified as stale. We show that this hard-filtering step can reduce downstream accuracy when resolver errors delete query-critical facts. Across three models, a controlled sensitivity intervention moves hard-drop from gains of +0.186 to +0.230 at perfect resolution to losses of -0.176 to -0.181 at the lowest tested reliability. Paired targeted interventions show that false-drop causes significantly greater degradation than false-keep, while a non-deleting baseline can still fail when incorrect labels steer generation. On a frozen 102/102 calibration/test split, a simple deployment-matched gate reaches 0.655 accuracy versus 0.641 for always hard-drop and 0.662 for test-informed oracle selection. Global-accuracy crossovers require gold labels and are model- and task-specific diagnostics, not deployment thresholds. Deletion should instead be treated as cost-sensitive: validate query-critical false-drop risk on matched data, or default to label-free retention when such validation is unavailable.

科研.title: 排名是否成立？对小型、量化、设备上法学硕士的幻觉探测器进行面向从业者的审计
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17339v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hallucination detection for large language models is dominated by methods evaluated on 7B-70B research models with abundant sampling budgets and exact-match or ROUGE correctness labels. The small models practitioners actually ship on-device, Phi-3-mini, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, and Gemma-2-2B-Instruct, typically at 4-bit precision, sit outside this evidence base. We present a reproducible one-GPU audit of four detectors spanning three paradigms: length-normalized token-margin calibration, a lexical n-gram baseline, and two sampling-based consistency methods (semantic entropy and SelfCheckGPT-NLI) on two small open instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct) loaded at 4-bit NF4 quantization on a single Colab T4 GPU, evaluated on closed-book TriviaQA. Cross-model ranking transfer is poor: Spearman rho is -0.80 and Kendall tau-b is -0.667, meaning the detector ranking actively inverts between the two models, and the cheap lexical baseline is statistically indistinguishable from the sampling-based consistency detectors on both models under bootstrap 95 percent confidence intervals. As a second, methodological contribution, we show that the standard token-overlap-to-multiple-choice correctness labeler for TruthfulQA-Generation produces near-chance AUROC (0.46-0.59) for all four detectors on both models, a labeler failure, not a detector failure, since the same detectors reach 0.69-0.89 AUROC on TriviaQA under the identical pipeline. We release the harness, prompts, and per-item scores and frame the detector choice explicitly as a fairness-of-error-rates allocation problem for practitioners deploying on resource-constrained, on-device hardware.

科研.title: LoRAWeaver：LoRA 表示空间中的定向适配器路由
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17340v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are expensive to update through full retraining. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning reduces the cost of adaptation, but repeated adaptation creates a growing pool of task-specific LoRA adapters. This pool complicates adapter selection during inference. Existing routing and encoder-based methods often require retraining when new adapters are added, which limits their use in dynamic settings. This paper treats adapter routing as a representation alignment problem in the adapter-output space. The proposed training-free method selects adapters by matching adapter-conditioned query representations against task prototypes using cosine similarity. Experiments with LLaMA-2-7B and LLaMA-2-13B on a 48-task FLAN-v2 benchmark and on out-of-distribution tasks show that the method outperforms training-free baselines in the cross-task setting and approaches a trained retrieval encoder without learning a router. An ablation confirms the benefit of directional alignment in the adapter-output space.

科研.title: 表格总体先验作为 EHR 药物集预测的结构化检索
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Medication prediction from electronic health records is a fixed vocabulary structured prediction problem, yet recent clinical RAG systems often treat it like open ended case based reasoning: retrieve similar patient admissions and ask an LLM to infer a medication set. This retrieval object is indirect the model receives retrieved patient records while the target is a discrete set of medication class labels. We propose a more task aligned retrieval object: a tabular population prior ranked medication class candidates from a sparse condition medication co occurrence table estimated from training admissions. Using PACERAG as a fixed downstream pipeline and replacing only its patient retriever, this drop in swap improves F1 from 0.303 to 0.338 (+11.5% relative) and Jaccard from 0.218 to 0.237 on 1,004 heldout MIMIC IV admissions, with no additional LLM calls and no inference time patient index. A non LLM top k baseline reaches F1=0.248, confirming the prior is predictive before LLM integration. Aggregate population statistics can provide a more task aligned, efficient, and auditable retrieval source than patient level nearest neighbors for fixed vocabulary EHR set prediction.

科研.title: 与反思推理保持一致：学习如何遵循原则
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The appropriate governing norms and principles for the alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) often depend on cultural context and deployment application. However, most alignment techniques focus on training models to conform to human preferences or constitutional principles specified at training time and subsequently fixed. In practice, many deployers rely on system prompting to implement contextual norms and guardrails at inference time. Prior work has shown that post-generation reflective reasoning with critique and revision can improve conformance compared to simple system prompting, but such methods are limited to the reasoning abilities inherent in the trained model. We introduce Reflect-Reasoning, a training method that teaches models how to reason about alignment to principles, rather than simply which principles to follow. Across five models, Reflect-Reasoning consistently outperforms both system prompting and explicit prompting strategies for in-context reflective reasoning. These improvements extend and generalize to entirely out-of-distribution domains of medical and financial principles. We additionally demonstrate that Reflect-Reasoning reduces the occurrence of rare but serious principle violations. Finally, we show that Reflect-Reasoning does not erode the safety engineering of a model and is robust against jailbreaking attempts using adversarial constitutions. Overall, our results demonstrate that Reflect-Reasoning is a scalable method for training constitutional alignment as a generalizable reasoning capability, enabling models to adapt to novel principles and produce transparent reasoning traces without additional fine-tuning.

科研.title: WETW：学习特定对的加权欧几里德距离以实现高效的 DTW 搜索
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is the standard distance for similarity search over time series that are misaligned in time, but its cost is quadratic in the series length and lower bounds often prune few candidates, so search over large collections of long series is slow. Learned approximations embed the series to make comparisons cheap, yet compare every pair with the same fixed rule, usually the Euclidean distance, although DTW aligns each pair differently. We observe that, once a pair is aligned, DTW is a Euclidean distance over coordinates selected for that pair. Building on this view, we propose Weighted Euclidean Time Warping (WETW), a learned distance that adapts the comparison of fixed-length embeddings to each pair. A small symmetric network predicts one weight per embedding di- mension and pair without computing an alignment, which halves the error of the best static distance on the same embeddings. The embeddings come from the Weighted Euclidean SEries Encoder (WESEE), whose multi-scale Temporal Feature Extractor keeps the timing information that global pooling removes and raises recall@1 from 0.90 to 0.95, although WETW works with any encoder. We also show that fitting DTW distances is not enough for search, as regression alone misorders the closest neighbours, and that ranking regularization raises recall@1 from 0.79 to 0.95. Our filter-and-verify pipeline, WETW-FV, uses WETW to build a shortlist and exact DTW to check it, so the search is approximate but every returned distance is exact. Over eight datasets, WETW-FV is 11.4x faster than the fastest exact method among the UCR Suite, lower bounds and MESSI-DTW, at a mean recall@10 of 0.93, while the best learned baseline reaches 0.59 at the same speed. On 48K-point series, WETW- FV remains 40x faster than the UCR Suite at a recall@10 of 0.91.

科研.title: 大步梯度下降分类：统一自稳定和收敛率
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks are often trained with gradient descent (GD) using step sizes that exceed classical stability thresholds, a regime where standard convergence theory no longer applies. Despite exhibiting non-monotonic loss and oscillatory dynamics, this regime frequently leads to faster convergence and better generalization. Existing theoretical perspectives offer complementary but incomplete insights: one identifies a self-stabilization mechanism that drives GD toward flat regions but does not yield convergence rates; another derives rigorous rates for specific losses but does not explain the underlying stabilization mechanism; and a third unifies these views for overparameterized least squares, but relies on the existence of a minimizer manifold, which is absent in classification settings. In this work, we extend this unified geometric perspective to exponential-tail losses, including logistic and cross-entropy losses in separable linear classification, where the loss infimum is not attained at any finite parameter. We identify a curvature-defined reference subspace that replaces the role of the minimizer manifold, yielding a coupled dynamical system in which orthogonal oscillations are damped by parallel progress along directions of decreasing sharpness. Under regularity conditions, which we verify for logistic and multiclass cross-entropy losses on symmetric data models, we derive explicit bounds for the iterates, not just the loss, covering both the unstable and stable regimes, and revealing a three-phase damping structure in the latter. Our analysis further uncovers a transient implicit bias induced by large step sizes: although GD converges asymptotically to the max-margin direction, large steps can leave persistent orthogonal residuals and, in certain geometries, amplify them, affecting finite-time alignment with the max-margin direction.

科研.title: 未完成的基准：测量现实工作环境中持久代理的规则违规情况
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17460v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents are increasingly equipped with persistence toward task completion to run delegated work autonomously for long periods, under many unstated constraints from internal documents and other people's authority. When completion requires violating a rule, the agent must decide alone, yet benchmarks of instruction-rule conflicts state the rule in the prompt or keep it hidden and do not evaluate persistence. We present Unfinished-Bench, a benchmark that gives models persistence in autonomous runs without a user, in realistic work environments with embedded rules. In each of its 97 scenarios across 7 organizations and 7 risk categories, the goal and the rule cannot both hold. We find that persistence raised violations of a rule in an internal document from 32.2% to 43.6%, five times the 8.5% for the same rule stated by the user. Of the document-rule violations, 98.3% occurred after the rule was displayed, and in 89% of a judged sample the agent first wrote down the rule. Violations of rules placed in the environment without user oversight can lead to serious incidents, so persistence-driven risks need to be evaluated. Benchmark documentation: https://francis21c.github.io/unfinished-bench/

科研.title: 接枝 Si/GeSn 异质结构中成分驱动的能带排列演化
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding and controlling band alignment in lattice-mismatched group-IV semiconductor-based heterostructures is fundamental to rational band-structure engineering, as it governs the electronic structure and carrier transport in heterointegrated semiconductor systems. Despite growing interest in Si/GeSn heterostructures, the composition-dependent band alignment has not been experimentally established. Here, we experimentally establish the evolution of band alignment in semiconductor-grafted Si/GeSn heterostructures with contents ranging from 8.8% to 12.4% using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and Kraut's core-level method. The valence-band offset increases systematically from ~0.29 to ~0.57 eV with increasing Sn composition, whereas the corresponding effective conduction-band offset decreases from ~0.30 to ~0.12 eV. The observed band-alignment evolution is attributed to an upward shift of the GeSn valence-band maximum arising from enhanced p-p orbital hybridization, reduced bonding-antibonding splitting, and compressive-strain-induced heavy-hole band lifting. These findings establish the experimental relationship between alloy composition and interfacial band alignment in semiconductor-grafted Si/GeSn heterostructures, providing a quantitative framework for rational band-structure engineering in lattice-mismatched group-IV semiconductor heterostructures.

科研.title: 带电纳米团簇通过表面扩散的变形动力学
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17514v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Low-temperature charged nanoclusters deform, primarily via surface diffusion, when surface electrostatic stresses and surface tension stresses are not balanced. We derive an analytical model for the kinetics of this process, based on the cluster size, net charge, surface tension, local curvature, temperature, and diffusivity. The model predicts the deformation time when either surface tension or electrostatic stress dominates, leading respectively to the collapse or elongation of the cluster. Comparison with molecular dynamics simulations of ice nanoclusters with solvated electrons shows quantitative agreement with a single fitted parameter. The model can predict the deformation kinetics of charged nanoclusters in atmospheric aerosols and complex plasmas.

科研.title: 沿着硅结构相变产生高次谐波
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17516v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore high-harmonic generation (HHG) in silicon treated by a variable dose from a Ga focused ion beam (Ga$^+$ FIB). We identify four qualitatively different dose regimes as the sample transitions from a crystalline to amorphous phase. The phase transition manifests as a giant enhancement in yield of low-order harmonics, which is strongly correlated with surface swelling as measured by atomic force microscopy. Below the critical dose, we observe a mixed phase regime where the HHG spectra display elements of both crystalline and amorphous silicon. We show how the samples can be laser-annealed with intense non-resonant pulses, where energy is deposited preferentially into amorphous regions, allowing us to disentangle the relative importance of chemical and structural modifications to the strong-field dynamics. At very high dose, we observe an increased sensitivity to laser-induced damage, which is correlated with FIB-induced etching. Energy dispersive x-ray spectroscopy reveals that laser damage leads to the formation of Ga-rich nanoparticles and porosity at the surface.

科研.title: 数据驱动的难熔高熵合金强度-延展性协同作用探索
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Refractory high-entropy alloys (RHEAs) have attracted increasing attention for their exceptional ability to retain strength at high temperatures. However, current research mainly concentrates on compositions close to equimolar alloys, leaving a large part of the composition space unexplored. Here, we develop a multiscale framework based on a data-driven dislocation genome method that constructs energy landscapes for edge dislocation motion across various compositions. The local configurational force derived from the energy landscape is incorporated into dislocation dynamics simulations, revealing a scaling law connecting macroscale strength and atomic-scale local resistance governed by fluctuations in the local configurational force. Based on this scaling law, a new solid-solution strengthening model for edge dislocation in BCC alloys is developed, followed by a data-driven exploration of refractory alloys considering both strength and ductility. The developed method and theory are adaptable, allowing for extension to other BCC alloy systems and guiding high-throughput alloy design.

科研.title: 大型非线性模拟电路中的对比局部学习
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17561v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning in physical hardware promises to reduce training cost by colocating computation, memory and adaptation within device physics. Contrastive local learning networks (CLLNs) offer a compelling route: an electrical circuit relaxes to equilibrium in free and weakly clamped states, and each adaptive element updates from local voltage contrasts rather than backpropagated error signals. Yet whether nonlinear transistor implementations can scale beyond proof-of-concept circuits, and what design principles control that scaling, have remained unknown. Here we show that nonlinear analog circuits trained by contrastive local rules can learn larger machine-learning tasks and remain robust under hardware nonidealities. Using device-level circuit simulations, we systematically explore initialization, operating regime, loss-dependent clamping and training parameters, and scale CLLNs beyond ten thousand adaptive edges. The same local rule trains classifiers that reach the accuracy regime of conventional digital methods on Ionosphere and handwritten-digit benchmarks, and a network that autoregressively generates language over a 122-token vocabulary. These results establish the feasibility of local learning in large nonlinear analog circuits.

科研.title: 电子辐照电介质的电荷相关电子发射产率
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.18486v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The total electron emission yield (TEEY) of dielectric surfaces may vary during electron irradiation owing to charge accumulation within the material. In the present work, the generation, transport, and escape formulation of Dionne is extended by introducing an additional attenuation of secondary electrons that depends on trapped positive charge. The resulting emission law is coupled to a charge-balance equation, allowing the TEEY to be calculated as a function of incident energy and injected charge. The model is examined using measurements on polycrystalline Al2O3, from which effective cross sections describing interactions between trapped charge and secondary electrons are determined. Their mean value is then used to predict the evolution of the TEEY curves without further adjustment. Finally, an analytical approximation of the nonlinear charging law is derived to facilitate the implementation in electron-irradiation simulations.

科研.title: 具有受限斯格明子的盲内存算术：斯格明子字节上的加倍和后继函数
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.18492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a skyrmionic-based computation platform, able to perform fully in-memory computing by collectively manipulating the skyrmions that serve as bits of the binary memory. The computation protocols are implemented through driving currents and adequately located anisotropy defects that modify the dynamics of the skyrmions along a magnetic track. Simulations demonstrating the feasibility of such an in-memory computing system are shown for several basic and simple mathematical operations with natural numbers, such as doubling and adding one (the successor function). We also discuss how further optimization of the geometry, barrier profiles, current amplitudes, and timing parameters could improve both the robustness and the overall practical feasibility of the system.

科研.title: 低成本浸入式冷却系统的设计和实验评估
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.17361v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper presents a low-cost, open-source, single-phase immersion cooling testbed for studying liquid cooling of data center hardware. A 500 W titanium heater, standing in for server load, is submerged in a glass tank of mineral oil, a dielectric fluid. The heated oil is circulated by a magnetic drive pump through an air-cooled radiator. An ESP32 microcontroller logs three DS18B20 temperature sensors (heater surface, bulk fluid and ambient) and switches the pump, fan and heater through a relay module. The complete system costs INR 35,318 (about USD 380), built entirely from components available in India. At quasi-steady state under the full 500 W load, the heater surface reached 118.3 {\deg}C while the bulk oil stayed at 29.3 {\deg}C, only 8.0 {\deg}C above ambient. Thermal-resistance analysis shows that the heater-to-oil interface, limited by natural convection, accounts for about 92% of the total resistance (178.0 vs 16.0 m{\deg}C/W). The external loop therefore has spare capacity. CAD files, firmware and data are openly available, so the setup can be reproduced and used to compare dielectric fluids, loads and flow arrangements.

科技.title: 华为 WATCH Air 新款智能手表外观曝光：圆润机身 + 超轻薄设计，预装鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 系统
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 16 日消息，博主 @鹏鹏君驾到 今日曝光了一款华为穿戴新品 —— HUAWEI WATCH Air 智能手表。 从画面可以看到，华为 WATCH Air 采用超轻薄设计，拥有圆润的弧面机身，侧边配有一枚旋转表冠按钮和一枚多功能按键。此外， 这款手表还预装了鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 系统 。 目前，华为官方暂未公布这款手表的具体配置信息，但爆料提到，这款手表将采用高亮钛一体化设计，提供黑、银、金三种配色。IT之家也将持续关注这款智能手表新品，并在第一时间带来最新情报。 延伸阅读 综合多位数码博主的爆料，WATCH Air 是华为一个全新的智能手表系列，定位介于现有产品线之间，主打轻薄与日常佩戴。 “Air”这一命名华为此前曾在手机产品上使用，如 2025 年发布的 Mate 70 Air。此次将 Air 概念延伸到智能手表，被视为面向追求轻巧、不喜厚重表体用户的新选择。 关于钛合金材质，其相比不锈钢重量大约轻 40% 至 50%，同时强度更高、耐腐蚀性更强、亲肤性更好。华为此前已在 GT 系列、Fit 系列的 Pro 机型上采用过钛合金或钛合金表圈，工艺积累较为成熟。 续航方面，有爆料称 Watch Air 将采用高硅叠片异形电池，硅含量超过 10%，能量密度提升约 6%，续航约为 5 天。功能上，其健康功能预计看齐 WATCH 6，运动功能看齐 WATCH GT 7 Pro。另有爆料提到该表配色可能多达 6 种。 作为参照，华为此前的 WATCH 5 于 2025 年 6 月发布，采用 316L 不锈钢表壳，支持 X-TAP 智感窗、腕上小艺、手势操控、eSIM 独立通话、一键微体检、ECG 心电分析等能力。

科技.title: 奇瑞捷途全新旅行者 7 C-DM 华为乾崑智驾版上市：搭载舱内激光 Limera，焕新价 18.49 万元起
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 16 日消息，奇瑞捷途全新旅行者 7 C-DM 华为乾崑智驾版方盒新车今晚正式上市， 超级焕新价 18.49 万元起 。该车基于全新旅行者 7 C-DM 打造，如命名所示，其搭载了华为乾崑智驾系统。 两驱 Max：上市指导价 18.99 万元、超级焕新价 18.49 万元； 四驱 Max+：上市指导价 19.99 万元、超级焕新价 19.49 万元； 四驱 Ultra：上市指导价 21.49 万元、超级焕新价 20.99 万元。 据介绍，该车选用华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 Pro 方案， 搭载的是舱内激光 Limera ，同时拥有 11V 高清摄像头（前视 / 环视 / 侧视 / 后视）、3R 毫米波雷达（前 / 侧后）和 12U 超声波雷达（周身全分布）；支持 WEWA 世界大模型，拥有 60EFLOPS AI 算力， 端训练里程达 100 亿+ 公里 。 奇瑞捷途全新旅行者 7 C-DM 华为乾崑智驾版 支持城区 NCA 和泊车辅助功能 ，提供三点式掉头、夜间环岛、乡村窄路领航辅助、窄道会车、三轮车横穿避让、泊车辅助（APA）、遥控泊车辅助（RPA）、自定义车位泊车等能力。 据IT之家此前报道， 奇瑞捷途全新旅行者 7 已于今年 10 月上市 ，当时共分 8 款车型，提供 1.5T 汽油、2.0T 汽油以及 1.5T 插混三种动力， 超级焕新价 12.59 万元起 。 1.5TD 两驱探索：上市指导价 13.99 万元，超级焕新价 12.59 万元 1.5TD 两驱探索 +：上市指导价 14.99 万元，超级焕新价 13.59 万元 2.0TD XWD 四驱发现：上市指导价 15.99 万元，超级焕新价 14.59 万元 2.0TD XWD 四驱穿越：上市指导价 16.99 万元，超级焕新价 15.59 万元 2.0TD XWD 四驱征服：上市指导价 17.99 万元，超级焕新价 16.59 万元 C-DM 两驱 Pro：上市指导价 15.29 万元，超级焕新价 14.39 万元 C-DM 两驱 Max：上市指导价 16.29 万元，超级焕新价 15.39 万元 C-DM 两驱 Max+：上市指导价 17.29 万元，超级焕新价 16.39 万元 该车的长宽高分别为 4827mm、2006mm、1875mm，轴距 2800mm。捷途全新旅行者 7 保留了外挂式储物箱（俗称“小书包”），并采用侧开式尾门。尾灯组内部经过熏黑处理。 捷途全新旅行者 7 提供搭载猎鹰 500 高阶智能辅助驾驶系统，基于地平线征程 6M 芯片，算力 128TOPS，采用端到端大模型。座舱方面，芯片升级为 8255。 该车全系标配 XWD 全自动智能四驱系统，并提供 7+X 一键越野模式。此系统可自动完成扭矩分配与限滑脱困，7 种固定驾驶模式可覆盖城市与户外多元出行场景。 捷途全新旅行者 7 的 1.5T 汽油版搭载 7 速双离合变速箱；2.0T 汽油版搭载 8AT 变速箱；1.5T 插电混动版匹配 3 挡 DHT 变速箱，匹配 45.12kWh 宁德时代电池，CLTC 纯电续航 251km，综合续航 1400km。

科技.title: 中国成功连任国际电信联盟理事国
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 16 日消息，据工信微报消息，11 月 16 日，国际电信联盟 2026 年全权代表大会完成国际电联理事国和无线电规则委员会委员选举工作， 中国成功连任国际电联理事国（2027—2030 年） ，中国候选人、国家数据集团有限公司董事程建军成功连任无线电规则委员会委员（2027—2030 年）。 据介绍，国际电联是联合国信息通信领域专门机构， 负责统筹协调全球无线电频谱与卫星轨道资源分配 ，制定全球通信技术标准，推动通信基础设施建设。 国际电联理事会由 48 个理事国组成，负责在两次全权代表大会之间履行管理机构职责 。无线电规则委员会由 12 名专家组成，负责解释无线电规则、补充完善规则程序，并协调解决成员国之间无线电频率干扰等问题。IT之家查询获悉，中国自 1972 年恢复在国际电联合法席位后，一直担任理事国。 程建军此次连任国际电联无线电规则委员会委员。目前，他担任该委员会副主席，根据该委员会相关工作规则， 他将于 2027 年担任委员会主席 。

科技.title: 微软称下一代 Xbox 游戏机能玩 PC 游戏
科技.summary: 微软证实，代号为 Project Helix 的下一代 Xbox 游戏机既能玩主机游戏也能玩 PC 游戏。但暂时还不清楚游戏机是否能运行 Steam、Epic 等竞争对手的 PC 游戏启动器。目前所知的信息是 Project Helix 使用了基于 AMD Zen6 CPU + RDNA5 GPU 的定制 APU，与 PC 使用的 APU 区别并不大（游戏机配备的 RDNA5 CU 数量更多），因此玩 PC 游戏没多少问题，问题在于它如何控制玩家玩任意 PC 游戏。负责 Project Helix 业务的副总裁 Jason Ronald 表示， “我们的设计目标非常明确：Helix 是一款游戏主机，同时也能玩 PC 游戏。它并非是一台能玩主机游戏的 PC。我们的目标是让玩家能简单、直观且即时地进入游戏。当然如果你是硬核玩家或资深用户，想要对各项设置和性能选项进行更深度的自定义，也完全可以实现。”他称 Helix 将移除游玩障碍，消除摩擦，打破过去人为设定的界限。
